2023-4770-4927-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

443-728-3249-4289--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
443-728-3249-4289--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Cryptolith Rite by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Magus of the Bridge triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

222-527-4247-7297.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-7297.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1496-1981-2415-2921.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1496-1981-2415-2921.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-5686-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-5686-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 5 or greater

3750-5471-7651.description:
Deal combat damage using Obeka, triggering its ability, causing you to get at least four extra upkeep steps.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Smaug triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 2 during each other extra upkeep step, creating at least four additional Treasures.
During your postcombat main phase, activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
3750-5471-7651.notes: You can attack with Samug if an opponent cannot block and kill with. This'll allow you to deal damage using its first ability.

112-4050-6747-7639.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
112-4050-6747-7639.description:
Cast Clockspinning by paying {U} due to Sami.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Clockspinning.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat.

4598-5195-7634.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Practiced Scrollsmith.
When Practiced Scrollsmith enters, it triggers, exiling Essence Flux from your graveyard with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Essence Flux from exile by paying its mana cost, targeting Practiced Scrollsmith.
Repeat from step 2.

3258-4499-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Emiel the Blessed. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-4499-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

1849-2366-3430-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1849-2366-3430-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

3967-6199-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Marionette Apprentice.
When Marionette Apprentice dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Marionette Apprentice enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1482-2534.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Jeweled Lotus.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Coercive Recruiter.
When Coercive Recruiter enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-2392-3291.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least three.
1978-2392-3291.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Repeat

1978-2416-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Rise and Shine.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

2760-3108-4661.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Vesuvan Doppelganger.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Vesuvan Doppelganger by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

500-2081-2556.description:
Cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing another creature, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Mnemonic Wall and creating two token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
When the Mnemonic Wall tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-2122-3062-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-3062-5231.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

225-765-774.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1575-4231-5330.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
1575-4231-5330.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing a Food.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure artifact token, a tapped Clue artifact token and a tapped Food artifact token.
Resolve the ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1238-2351-2438-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

457-1409-2557.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Urza enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Urza.
Resolve the Urza trigger, creating two 0/0 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping the Constructs, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat.

567-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
567-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

3129-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2440-2805-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Spirits.
2440-2805-3263.description:
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying {5}.
When Kiri-Onna enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Kiri-Onna trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control five Spirits except Kiri-Onna, this combo will net infinite mana.

1479-3478-4862.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-4862.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Omnath, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Omnath trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Omnath trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
